from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class LiabilityRecord(BaseModel):
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company that filed the report")
    total_liabilities: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of Total Liabilities as reported in the text")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit or scale of the reported value (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands')")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The date or period for which the liabilities are reported")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text containing the liability value and label")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    liability_records: list[LiabilityRecord]
